why: The Chair's count of a minority by a show of hands ("One against. The Ayes have it.") is not a division; the row stays on the review list as a total with no second count (the Bill report of SPRS id 00069442-ZZ, 31 August 1982).
rows: Question put, "That clause 2 stand part of the Bill."
Do you really want a Division to be taken, or a show of hands?
Yes, that is easier. The Question is, "That clause 2 stand part of the Bill." As many as are of the opinion, say "aye". Show your hands.
To the contrary, say "No", and show your hands.
One against. The Ayes have it.
Clause 2 accordingly ordered to stand part of the Bill.
Bill reported without amendment; read a Third time and passed.
